t: You're in Egerton Gardens, a street and communal garden in South Kensington, the kind usually called a garden square. The houses face onto the shared greenery. Two residents are linked to it. Bessie Hamilton Johnston, an artist who lived from 1860 to 1943, lived here. And Kenelm Pepys, the fifth Earl of Cottenham, was born here in 1901. He died young, in 1922, at just twenty-one.
